expectations.text: Report contains a mermaid diagram at container level (services, datastores, queues/entry points), not ASCII art
expectations.evidence: architecture-diagram.md contains a 'flowchart TB' mermaid diagram with frontend/Caddy, backend, postgres, CronJobs (data-refresh, livetrade), trading-operator, ibkr-broker, ibkr-gateway, worker Jobs, trading_mcp and the legacy cli/auto_trade.py path, plus a dead-path legend using classDef styling.

expectations.text: Chose an existing docs home (spec/ or DEVELOPMENT.md) as the persistence target instead of inventing a new tree, and named the intended path
expectations.evidence: Report states the diagram 'belongs in the repo at DEVELOPMENT.md, under the existing "Distributed compute & live trading" section (currently prose-only)... per this repo's own docs convention'. Verified DEVELOPMENT.md:329 has exactly that pre-existing section. This uses an existing, already-documented home rather than inventing a new file/tree.

expectations.text: Ran the reverse check: lists doc-only nodes/edges (in docs but not in code) alongside code-only ones, because spec/ already documents architecture
expectations.evidence: No systematic doc-vs-code reverse check is performed. The report only mentions in passing that 'spec/README.md already carries a higher-altitude flowchart... this diagram sits one level below it' (Diagrams section) -- it does not enumerate doc-only nodes/edges vs code-only ones as a distinct comparison.

expectations.text: Each dead-interface / dead-service finding names both ends of the edge with path:line evidence, and distinguishes 'no producer' from 'no consumer'
expectations.evidence: Findings name files and functions (e.g. 'backend/routers/simulations.py defines list_simulations()... not services/frontend/src/lib/api.ts (no simulations entry)') but give no specific line numbers for either end in any of the boundary findings. The substance (producer exists, no consumer) is present, but the assertion's path:line requirement is not met.

expectations.text: Did not stage or commit any file, and did not write docs into the repo when told not to
expectations.evidence: Report states 'Nothing was written into the trading repo' and the diagram file was saved only to outputs/architecture-diagram.md, not the repo. Real repo git status confirms no DEVELOPMENT.md changes.

expectations.text: Identified at least one real edge type beyond HTTP (postgres tables, k8s CRs, crons, or the IBKR socket)
expectations.evidence: Report and diagram describe Postgres writes (prices, results, live_orders/fills/trade_log tables), AutoTrade/StrategyConfig CRs, CronJobs (data-refresh-open/close, livetrade-open/close), and the IBKR gateway TWS/paper API.
